g.text: Target Ordinary Integer Paging - Oldest First
Validate positive integers and offset bounds
Resolve current branch and current access
First page and one possible extra event
nextPage = 2 if extra event exists, else null
Commit new complete events at the tail
New records may enter later pages.
Resolve current branch and visible complete events
Page plus one possible extra event
nextPage = page + 1 if extra event, else null
null means no next page at query time, not execution finished.
Reload page 1 if branch, filter or page size changes.
No automatic cross-page change detection is promised.
No automatic replay of accepted POST requests.
Use sourceEventId for root ownership, not as a paging cursor.
